The '''Coruscant Central Court''' was located in the [[Administrative Sector]] and contained the offices and courtrooms of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Coruscant Central Court|Central Court]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] it was the location of a [[Coruscant Administrative Sector terrorist attack|terrorist attack]].
